concepts.def: Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Formulae & Equations — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Formulae & Equations brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Formulae & Equations.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
